subject.title: fix(line): record every LINE push message id in send receipts

question: Must the contributor attach inspectable redacted output from the exact-head credential-backed LINE push and reply runs, or is the unaccompanied proof claim sufficient?
rationale: Credential-backed proof was explicitly required in maintainer review, but the visible workflow checks prose and no runtime artifact is available for independent inspection.

options.title: Require inspectable output
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted push and reply results show ordered provider IDs and `[media, text]` receipt kinds on the current head.

options.title: Accept the proof claim
options.body: Treat the contributor's description of the credential-backed run as sufficient despite the absence of reviewable runtime output.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable output
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted push and reply results show ordered provider IDs and `[media, text]` receipt kinds on the current head.
